manual_requirement.question: Does every IAM Roles Anywhere profile restrict session permissions (session policy or managed policy ARNs) to the minimum required?
manual_requirement.title: IAM Roles Anywhere profile restricts session permissions
manual_requirement.guidance: Whether a profile's session policy is sufficiently restrictive depends on the roles and workloads it serves; review ManagedPolicyArns and SessionPolicy of each profile.

manual_requirement.question: Do Route 53 A records in public hosted zones point only to IP addresses owned by this account (no dangling public IPs that allow subdomain takeover)?
manual_requirement.title: Route 53 A records do not point to released public IP addresses
manual_requirement.guidance: The prowler check joins every public hosted zone record with all account EIPs, all ENI public IPs and the published AWS ip-ranges across regions. The native per-scope snapshot does not hold the account-wide EIP/ENI join nor the ip-ranges feed, so review each A record IP against currently owned addresses.

manual_requirement.question: Does each Secrets Manager secret have a resource policy that explicitly denies access to every principal except the intended roles and services?
manual_requirement.title: Secrets Manager secret resource policy is restrictive (explicit deny for non-approved principals)
manual_requirement.guidance: Prowler evaluates a deep, organisation-specific policy shape (explicit Deny with aws:PrincipalArn/aws:PrincipalServiceName exceptions and condition operators). Review each secret policy against your approved principal list.
